content.text: Nvidia's promise, made in an 8-K filed 2025-11-19, was that it

citations.cited_text: •Revealed plans to accelerate seven new supercomputers, including with Oracle to build the U.S. Department of Energy’s largest AI supercomputer, Solstice, featuring 100,000 NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, plus another system, Equinox, featuring 10,000 NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs.

content.text: revealed plans to accelerate seven new supercomputers, including with Oracle to build the U.S. Department of Energy's largest AI supercomputer, Solstice, featuring 100,000 NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, plus another system, Equinox, featuring 10,000 NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs.

The promise states no deadline. The later filings reviewed, running through the 8-K filed 2026-08-26, do not mention Solstice or Equinox by name or report how many Blackwell GPUs have been installed in either system. They do describe other supercomputer activity, such as

citations.cited_text: •Announced that the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform delivers world-class supercomputers for science; announced a record 35 new NVIDIA AI HPC supercomputers in development across Europe.

content.text: a record 35 new NVIDIA AI HPC supercomputers in development across Europe
, but that does not address the two named systems. Because no later filing reports progress on these specific targets, the status is "No evidence yet."

citations.cited_text: •Announced that NVIDIA is working with the South Korea government and industrial leaders, including Hyundai Motor Group, Samsung Electronics, SK Group and NAVER Cloud, to expand the nation’s AI infrastructure with over a quarter-million NVIDIA GPUs.

content.text: Announced that NVIDIA is working with the South Korea government and industrial leaders, including Hyundai Motor Group, Samsung Electronics, SK Group and NAVER Cloud, to expand the nation's AI infrastructure with over a quarter-million NVIDIA GPUs.
That promise appeared in the 8-K filed 2025-11-19. The later 8-K filed 2026-08-26 reports that

citations.cited_text: •Expanded Korea’s AI factory ecosystem through strategic partnerships with SK Telecom, NAVER and Brookfield to build sovereign AI infrastructure at gigawatt scale on the NVIDIA DSX platform, as part of a broader NVIDIA-powered national AI push across Korea’s industries and research institutions.

content.text: NVIDIA expanded Korea's AI factory ecosystem through strategic partnerships with SK Telecom, NAVER and Brookfield to build sovereign AI infrastructure at gigawatt scale on the NVIDIA DSX platform

, but it does not report a count of NVIDIA GPUs deployed in South Korea. The promise states no deadline, and no later filing reports a GPU count against the quarter-million figure, so the status is "No evidence yet."
Nvidia's 8-K filed 2025-11-19 says the company was

citations.cited_text: •Revealed that NVIDIA is working with partners including CoreWeave, Microsoft and Nscale to build the U.K.’s next generation of AI infrastructure, and announced an investment of £2 billion in the U.K. market.

content.text: working with partners including CoreWeave, Microsoft and Nscale to build the U.K.'s next generation of AI infrastructure, and announced an investment of £2 billion in the U.K. market.
